translations.web: So then both he who gives his own virgin in marriage does well, and he who doesn’t give her in marriage does better.
translations.bsb: So then, he who marries the virgin does well, but he who does not marry her does even better.
translations.kjv: So then he that giveth her in marriage doeth well; but he that giveth her ➔ not in marriage doeth better.
translations.asv: So then both he that giveth his own virgin daughter in marriage doeth well; and he that giveth her not in marriage shall do better.
